definitions.gloss: to take time; to be time-consuming; to have difficulty with
definitions.explanation: To spend more time than expected on something, often due to complications or difficulty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}って⟦{遅刻|ちこく}した→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I was late because the preparations took longer than expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm having difficulty with the paperwork procedures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}ってしまった。
examples.english: It took more time than I thought.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷造|にづく}り→荷造り：07938_nizukuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}って、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: Packing for the move took longer than expected, and I fell behind schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}って、⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧いっぱい⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I struggled with setting up the new system and it ended up taking the entire morning.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
Pattern: [task]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}る

ASPECT (ている):
{手間取|てまど}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates currently struggling with something time-consuming.

- {手間取|てまど}らない (negative)
- {手間取|てまど}って (te-form)
- {手間取|てまど}った (past)

FORMS:
⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧ (time and effort) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}る - to take time with preparations
- ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}る - to struggle with work
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手間取|てまど}る - to take longer than expected
